arrive.text: A shared pasture, with no rules yet. Anyone may graze their sheep here.

herders.text: Four neighbours and you, two sheep each. With so few sheep, the grass grows back as fast as it's eaten.

neighbour_adds.text: The blue house adds a sheep. It's their right.

add_1.text: One more sheep. A little more wool for you. The grass belongs to everyone.

follow.text: Your neighbours notice. Two of them add sheep too.

ask.text: Each extra sheep is all profit to its owner, and the cost is shared by everyone. So why would anyone stop?

take_back.text: You take one of yours back to the pen. Nobody follows.

bell_early.text: You ring the bell. The neighbours come, look at the thick grass, and wander home again.

bell.text: You ring the bell. The neighbours gather.

agree_1.text: You go first. Your own sheep go back to the pen.

agree.text: Then the others. Nobody owns the grass, but together you agree to look after it.

collapse.text: The grass is gone. For everyone.

held_end.text: You held back. They didn't. The grass went anyway.

took_back_end.text: You took yours back. It wasn't enough on your own.

sheep.text: This one's yours: the teal mark. She has no idea about any of this.

wool.text: Your wool. More sheep, more wool. For now.
